pages.text: Augments are upgrades for $(l:tinkering/essence_tools)Essence Tools$() and $(l:tinkering/essence_armor)Essence Armor$(). You add Augments to your gear using a $(l:tinkering/tinkering_table)Tinkering Table$(). $(br2)Each Augment has a tier assigned to it, designating the minimum tier of gear piece required to equip it.

pages.title: Fabrication
pages.text: You can see what each Augment does in the 'Augments' section of this guide.
